context_card.cerita: Guci biru peninggalan Kakek dipindah Nenek tiap minggu supaya "semua ruangan kebagian". Pagi ini Nenek menemukan serpihannya disembunyikan di ruang tamu. Guci itu pecah kemarin sore, dan pelakunya diam saja.

clue_awal.teks: Sapu selalu ada di dapur. Kalau gucinya kena sapu, pasti pecahnya di dapur.

rt_kolong.teks: Serpihan guci dibungkus koran di kolong sofa, bercampur serpih cat cokelat dari daun pintu yang terbanting keras.

rt_telepon.teks: Pesan Pak Tono di samping telepon: "Pintu dapur dan pintu ruang tamu dilepas untuk dicat sejak siang."

rt_tirai.teks: Dari jendela terlihat pintu teras diganjal batu bata sejak kemarin. Pintunya tidak bisa ditutup, apalagi dibanting.

rt_meja.teks: Catatan Mbok Sri di meja kopi: "Pak Joko seharian di kebun, tidak masuk rumah sama sekali."

rt_rak.teks: Daftar tulisan tangan Nenek terselip di rak buku: "Guci minggu ini: Ruang Kerja."

rt_sofa.teks: Sebuah buku farmasi tertinggal di sofa. Halaman "Mengelola Emosi" dilipat ujungnya.

rt_jam.teks: Jam dinding tepat waktu. Pak Tono mencocokkannya dengan jam tangannya setiap pagi.

rt_foto.teks: Di foto ini guci biru itu masih utuh, berdiri di samping Kakek. Kamu jadi ikut sedih.

rt_lukisan.teks: Lukisan sawah dan gunung. Miringnya sedikit, tapi memang sudah begitu sejak dulu.

rt_lemari.teks: Lilin, korek api, dan setumpuk struk belanja Mbok Sri.

rt_keset.teks: Keset bertuliskan "Selamat Datang". Huruf S-nya sudah hampir hilang.

rt_kursi.teks: Si Belang tidur pulas di kursi. Ia jelas tidak tahu apa-apa, atau pura-pura.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Tidak ada yang aneh di sini.

penjelasan.teks: Pelakunya bersepatu di bawah 42: Sekar atau Pak Joko.
Ada serpih cat pintu di antara serpihan: gucinya jatuh karena pintu dibanting.
Menurut catatan Nenek, minggu ini guci ada di Ruang Kerja. Pintu dapur, ruang tamu, dan teras juga tidak bisa dibanting.
Pak Joko tidak masuk rumah, jadi tidak mungkin di Ruang Kerja. Pelakunya Sekar.

komentar_nenek: Sekar, kesal sama Dimas boleh. Membanting pintu sampai guci Kakek jatuh, jangan.

en.cerita: Grandma moves Grandpa's old blue vase to a different room every week so that "every room gets a turn." This morning she found its pieces hidden in the living room. The vase broke yesterday afternoon, and the culprit kept quiet.

clue_awal.A1: The culprit wears shoes smaller than size 42.
clue_awal.A2: The broom always stays in the kitchen. If the vase was hit by the broom, it must have broken in the Kitchen.

benda.rt_kolong: Pieces of the vase are wrapped in newspaper under the sofa, mixed with brown paint chips from a door that was slammed hard.
benda.rt_telepon: Mr. Tono's note by the phone: "The kitchen door and the living room door were taken off for painting this afternoon."
benda.rt_tirai: From the window you can see the porch door propped open with a brick since yesterday. It can't be closed, let alone slammed.
benda.rt_meja: Mbok Sri's note on the coffee table: "Mr. Joko was in the garden all day and never came inside."
benda.rt_rak: A handwritten list from Grandma is tucked into the bookshelf: "Vase this week: Study."
benda.rt_sofa: A pharmacy textbook was left on the sofa. The page "Managing Your Emotions" has its corner folded.
benda.rt_jam: The wall clock is right on time. Mr. Tono checks it against his watch every morning.
benda.rt_foto: In this photo the blue vase is still whole, standing next to Grandpa. It makes you a little sad.
benda.rt_lukisan: A painting of rice fields and a mountain. It's slightly crooked, but it's always been like that.
benda.rt_lemari: Candles, matches, and a pile of Mbok Sri's shopping receipts.
benda.rt_keset: The doormat says "Selamat Datang" (Welcome). The S has almost worn away.
benda.rt_kursi: Belang is fast asleep on the armchair. Clearly knows nothing, or is pretending.

penjelasan: The culprit wears shoes under size 42: Sekar or Mr. Joko.
There are door paint chips among the pieces: the vase fell because a door was slammed.
According to Grandma's list, the vase was in the Study this week. The kitchen, living room, and porch doors couldn't be slammed anyway.
Mr. Joko never came inside, so it couldn't have been him in the Study. The culprit is Sekar.
en.komentar_nenek: Sekar, you can be annoyed with Dimas. Slamming the door until Grandpa's vase falls, no.
